title: Senior Executive - Airline Partnerships
jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Executive – Airline Partnerships Summary: Part of the Airline Partnerships team responsible for supporting the development, implementation, management, and optimization of strategic airline partnerships, including codeshare, interline, and alliance agreements. The role involves coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, managing partnership projects, supporting regulatory approvals, and ensuring successful technical and commercial integration of partner airlines. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Partnership Development & Management Support the implementation and negotiation of airline partnership initiatives, including codeshare, interline, and other commercial agreements. Contribute to the overall development, management, and growth of airline partnership relationships. Maintain effective communication with relevant internal departments regarding ongoing commercial agreements and partnership initiatives. Build and maintain strong relationships with partner airlines and key stakeholders. Analysis & Reporting Conduct independent analysis of partnership performance, market developments, and industry trends. Develop reports and dashboards to track alliance and partnership project progress. Assess emerging domestic and international aviation policies and evaluate competitor alliance and partnership activities. Project Management & Implementation Support special projects and strategic assignments related to airline partnerships. Manage technical, functional, and business implementation activities for codeshare, interline, and partnership programs. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution and seamless execution of partnership initiatives. Monitor project timelines, key deliverables, dependencies, and implementation milestones. Regulatory & Commercial Support Support efforts to obtain regulatory approvals, traffic rights, and government clearances required for partnership operations. Assist in managing irregularity and passenger re-protection agreements with partner airlines. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and commercial requirements. Systems & Technology Integration Coordinate IT integration activities for new and existing partners. Manage project execution related to system upgrades, enhancements, and partner onboarding. Collaborate with technology teams to ensure successful deployment and maintenance of partnership-related systems and interfaces. Execution Work closely with Commercial, Network Planning, Revenue Management, Airport Operations, Finance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams to execute partnership initiatives effectively. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful implementation and ongoing management of airline partnership programs. Preferred Skills: Strong understanding of airline operations, airline partnerships, and the aviation industry. Excellent communication, presentation, and business writing skills. Strong negotiation and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to build and sustain long-term professional relationships. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment. High level of autonomy and ownership while managing assigned projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point, and Word. Knowledge of airline commercial agreements, codeshare, and interline partnerships will be preferred. Qualifications and Experience Educational Qualification Preference for Post-Graduate degree in Management or equivalent discipline. Professional Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in an airline, aviation consultancy, or related airline commercial environment. Strong understanding of airline operations, commercial partnerships, and industry dynamics. Preferred Experience Experience in airline alliances, partnerships, network planning, commercial strategy, or aviation consulting. Exposure to codeshare, interline, and regulatory approval processes will be an added advantage. Location & Work Mode: Location: Gurgaon Work Mode: Work From Office (all 5 days)

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES:
Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent negotiation and influencing abilities. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills. Capability to handle multiple priorities under pressure. Strategic thinking and problem-solving mindset. Attention to detail and execution excellence. Proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented approach. Continuous improvement mindset with ability to recommend process enhancements.

title: Lead Auditor - Quality Team
jobDescription: ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA MANDATORY DESIRABLE Professional Qualification/knowledge AME Diploma / B. Tech with relevant experience Work Experience -Relevant/ Total Years Exp. Of 5-7 years in aviation; if unscheduled airline, 6-8 years IT skills MS Office (Word/ Excel/ PPT) Additional / Specific Licenses Required ISO 9001:2015 Lead auditor certification. Behavioural Competencies Independent Decisions making skills Effective Communication Skills Location Bangalore Job Description Should have acquired thorough knowledge of Organisational Policy and Procedures such as MOE, CAME, MTOE, TPM, ETPM, WSM & QAM. Review the Credentials received for new vendor for administered on AVL. Review the new Audit Check List prepared based on the new/ revised guidelines issued by the DGCA, Updated Company procedures or International Standards such as IATA MNTs or set-up of new facility within the IGO. Perform the audit as per monthly audit duties meticulously and assess any hidden risk. Review of the audit corrective action submitted by the Auditee and Check for correct Root cause analysis and the preventive action and corrective actions are taken properly to prevent repetition of findings. Complete the audit check list in the AMOS QA-Module for audit executed. Upload systematically all the evidences received during the audit. Prepare the audit closure report and intimate the Auditee for satisfactory closure of the audit. He should carry out the audit as per audit Protocol i.e. Prior to start of audit, audit briefing is conducted and then post conduct of audit, audit debriefing is made. Carry out Spot Audit as and when the audit manager assigns the duties. He/ she should prepare and submit to the Sr.Manager the Monthly Audit Forecast. Carry out the Vendor audit, MRO scheduled audit, Prestart audit for new up-coming station. Carry out diligently the scope enhancement audit of existing station. Carry out Station SRA audit along with Flight Safety team. Carry out Fuel vendor audit. Prepare the Agenda PPT for the Accountable Manager Six monthly meeting. Devise any creative continuity plan to check the audit plan is effective and in line with the organization's objectives.

title: Senior Manager - Customer Service Training
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Senior Manager – ifly CCU Job Title : Senoir Manager – Customer Service Training Role Highlights / Summary : Lead ifly CCU centre operations with focus on training delivery, regulatory compliance, stakeholder management, and operational excellence while ensuring adherence to DGCA/IOSA standards. Typical Interfaces Associate Director – SEP Training; Trainers/Facilitators; Admin, IT, Security & Maintenance Teams; HR & Facility Management; External Vendors. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Audit, Compliance & Regulatory Oversight Lead and manage all audits and compliance requirements related to training and facility operations. Ensure adherence to DGCA/IOSA guidelines and internal regulatory standards. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records for all operational and training activities.
2. Team Management Provides strategic leadership and direction to the team, ensuring alignment with organizational vision, goals & values Builds, develops, and retains teams through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning. Fosters a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Establishes clear performance expectations, conducts regular reviews, and drives a high-performance culture. Identifies talent, develops future leaders, and creates individual development plans. Leads organizational change initiatives and supports teams through transformation. Resolves complex people and operational issues with fairness, professionalism, and judgment. Encourages innovation, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional collaboration. Driving employee engagement, well-being, and recognition initiatives to enhance team morale and productivity. Partners with senior leadership and key stakeholders to achieve strategic business outcomes Builds an environment of trust, transparency, and open communication.
3. Training Delivery & Quality Management Monitor and enhance training programs across operational disciplines. Ensure consistent quality, regulatory compliance, and adoption of industry best practices. Track and improve training-related OTP (On-Time Performance) and quality metrics. Maintain comprehensive training data to support informed, data-driven decision-making. Ensuring the trainers are upskilled, maximum utilization of instructors and the travel from outstation to ifly- CCU is reduced
3. Stakeholder & Facilitator Management Act as the primary point of contact for all facilitators based at ifly-CCU and visiting trainers. Act as the SPOC for all administrative roles including catering, transport and any other vendor management etc. Ensure smooth coordination of training sessions and logistical arrangements.
4. Operational Excellence & Process Optimization Ensure trainees visiting ifly – CCU their well-being is taken care of. Oversee daily operations ensuring: Adherence to SOPs and protocols Achievement of defined KRAs / KPIs for ifly – CCU Continuously optimize operational workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
5. Interdepartmental Coordination & Communication Facilitate regular cross-functional meetings to: Identify operational challenges Drive collaborative solutions Support continuous improvement initiatives
6. People Engagement & Workplace Culture Foster open communication and provide support to employees during challenging situations. Promote a positive, approachable, and resilient work environment. Drive the ifly culture across Admin, IT, Security, and Maintenance teams. Support HR/Admin in seamless onboarding and induction processes.
7. Facility & Administrative Management Act as the primary point of contact for administrative concerns. Liaise with Regional Head and Facility Management for prompt issue resolution. Ensure all facility-related documentation is maintained, up-to-date, and compliant. Oversee transport operations in line with organizational guidelines.
8. Infrastructure, IT & Asset Management Conduct regular health checks of administrative and IT assets. Coordinate timely maintenance, upgrades, and repairs to ensure uninterrupted operations.
9. Employee Experience & Welfare Monitor feedback on food services and ensure high quality standards are maintained. Encourage employee engagement initiatives and participation in regional events to boost morale.
10. Reporting & Escalation Proactively report challenges, risks, or inconsistencies to the Associate Director – SEP Training (BOM). Collaborate to drive timely resolution and operational continuity. Tools & Resources : Training systems DGCA/IOSA frameworks MIS tools Facility management systems Required Skills : Aviation compliance knowledge Training operations expertise Stakeholder management, analytical ability Problem-solving Communication skills Qualifications and Experience : Graduate/Postgraduate with relevant aviation/training/operations experience Reporting : Associate Director – SEP Training Location & Work Mode : Kolkata – Full-time, On-site

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES:
Leadership Collaboration Result orientation Adaptability, Attention to detail

title: Senior Executive - Customer Experience
jobDescription:
The role is pivotal in managing customer complaints and queries, ensuring timely and seamless resolutions. The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent communication skills, resilience in high-pressure situations, and a strong customer-centric approach to drive satisfaction and strengthen Indi Go’s service reputation. Key Responsibilities Respond promptly and professionally to customer complaints and queries through email and outbound/inbound calls. Conduct extensive outbound calls to drive resolution, validate customer concerns, and ensure complete satisfaction. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Airport Operations, Inflight Services, Contact Centre, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Notifications, OCC, Codeshare, Ancillary, Sales, and Revenue Management. Maintain accurate, detailed records of customer interactions, issues, and resolutions. Identify opportunities for improvement within existing policies and processes to enhance customer experience. Assess the sensitivity of escalations and determine associated legal, regulatory, and reputational risks. Behavioural Competencies High resilience and emotional maturity in handling challenging situations and diverse customer profiles. Strong customer-centric mindset with a focus on trust-building and relationship management. Excellent negotiation and persuasion abilities. Agility and adaptability in a dynamic operational environment. Proactive learner with a continuous improvement mindset. Strong time-management, prioritization, and multitasking skills. Collaborative and dependable team player. Technical Skills Proficiency in English and Hindi (verbal and written). Strong typing and documentation skills with high attention to detail. High technical aptitude with the ability to intuitively navigate new systems and tools. Intermediate to advanced proficiency in MS Office applications. Eligibility Criteria

EDUCATION:
Graduate in any discipline. Experience: 1-3 years of experience in email and voice processes, preferably in grievance management Significant experience handling the Indian customer base. Prior experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and reporting to mid/senior leadership. Industry Expertise: Strong understanding of customer-facing and backend aviation processes across multiple touchpoints. Deep knowledge of global aviation regulations, conventions, and compliance standards. Clear understanding of inter-departmental workflows and ownership matrices within the aviation ecosystem. Work Environment: Comfortable with rotational shifts and rotational weekly offs (including night shifts). Work-from-office role based in Gurgaon . Diversity & Inclusion Statement At Indi Go, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace. All employment decisions are based solely on merit and qualifications, without regard to gender, race, color, religion, caste, creed, ethnicity, language, sexual orientation, marital status, maternity status, disability, or social and economic background. title: Senior Executive - Revenue Management
jobDescription:
Job Title : Sr. Executive – Revenue Management Role Highlights / Summary: Revenue Management
- Sr. Executive shall be tasked with developing and maximizing the revenue opportunities for the airline. The role requires strong analytical skills and ability to deliver expected unit revenues in a highly competitive market scenario. Typical Interfaces: Sales Team Network Planning Pricing & Revenue Management Teams Commercial & Strategy Teams External market/industry stakeholders Key Responsibility: Optimize Revenue on assigned flights Meet monthly Revenue and Passenger Revenue per Available Seat Kilometers (PRASK) target. Inventory positioning on assigned flights based on demand and seasonal patterns. Monitor and adjust fares based on market inputs and demand, ensure Indi Go offers competitive fare. Coordination with sales teams and other stakeholders to understand the market scenario and position Indi Go's fare accordingly. Manage demand forecast by analyzing historical and future trends on assigned flights to ensure revenue maximization. Ensure that overbooking is economically viable. Utilize Indi Go’s RM systems to drive optimized revenue and calibrate system inputs to have optimized results. Comprehensive reporting of competitor activity. Tools & Resources: Revenue Management Systems (RMS) MS Excel Power BI / Data Visualization Tools Internal pricing and analytics tools Required Skills: Strong analytical and data interpretation skills Understanding of airline pricing, forecasting, and inventory control Advanced Excel and reporting capability Ability to work in a fast-paced, competitive environment Stakeholder coordination and communication Qualifications and Experience: Minimum Graduate Required 3–5 years of relevant experience in Revenue Management Experience with pricing, demand forecasting, and airline metrics Certifications: Certifications in Analytics / Data Tools (preferred) Reporting: Manager – Revenue Management Location & Work Mode Location: Gurgaon Work Mode: Work From Office, all 5 days Mandatory Behavioral Competencies Strong problem-solving mindset Attention to detail Proactive and ownership-driven approach Ability to perform under pressure Collaboration and teamwork

title: Fleet Engineer (A&C)
jobDescription: Job Description- Fleet Engineer (A&C) Team- Line Maintenance ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA MANDATORY DESIRABLE Educational Qualification 10+ 2 and AME Diploma (Aircraft Maintenance Engineer) Others Full-scope authorization on A-320 or ATR Work Experience -Relevant/ Total Years Min. 10 years of certifying exp. On A320/ATR IT skills MS Office, excel, Power point Behavioural Competencies Collaborative approach, Good Interpersonal skills, Time management Job Responsibilities The Fleet Engineer must ensure that his AME license/ Authorisation is current and valid on the type of aircraft/engine/systems to be certified by him. To carry out the inspection and certification of work pertaining to the maintenance of airframe and power plant systems and components within the scope of his Licence/ Authorisation. To ensure that all work performed in connection with maintenance is in accordance with the requirements/recommendations of the manufacturers. It should also be ensured the approved methods, tooling, procedures and materials are used in carrying out the said work. To ensure all work orders, inspection schedules, are properly completed & certified before issuing CRS. To ensure the snags observed during inspections and those reported by the flight crew during the flight are rectified in an approved method. title: Analyst - Network Planning
jobDescription:
Analyst- Network Planning The selected candidate will join a group of high-quality experts in the field of schedule design, implementation and management in an area that is mission critical for the success of the airline. The role will include responsibility & involvement in the following areas: • Study and analyze various reports related to route performance and communicate findings and suggestions to the relevant teams for further actions as required. • Monitor results of action taken and suggest further action if required. • Monitor competitor activity and suggest relevant actions to be taken on Indi Go’s network. • Conduct demand analysis and develop traffic forecasts for new routes and flights. • Create & present business cases for new destinations/routes. • Develop frequency plans for the Indi Go network. • Generate reports in a timely manner after collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. • Optimise schedule design to maximise connectivity within Indi Go network & with partner network, provide passenger friendly pattern of service, aircraft rotations with considerations to available fleet and operational constraints. • Participate in ad hoc special projects related to Network Planning as per requirement. Qualities the role will require • Strong analytical skills with comfort in dealing with large, often unstructured masses of information. • The candidate should have conceptual clarity on basic statistical techniques. • Energetic, passionate and self-driven individual. • Excellent knowledge of MS Excel & exposure to BI platforms to design dashboards for reporting and analysis purposes. • Comfort with an amorphous and fast-paced environment, requiring creativity and autonomous initiative. • Good oral communication and strong interpersonal skills. • The candidate should be highly detail-oriented, process-oriented, and able to multitask effectively. • Candidate will be participating from time to time in confidential evaluations and projects and will be expected to handle such projects with high level of integrity and discretion. Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor’s / Master’s in Math / Statistics / Operations Research / Economics / Business / Aviation / Engineering. • 1-3 years of experience in Airline Network Planning/ Revenue Management/ Pricing or any analytical/ commercial function in an airline will be preferred. • Capabilities in Advanced Excel with ability to work with VB and build Excel Macros. • Knowledge of statistical concepts. • Knowledge of Business Intelligence (BI) / Data Visualization tools like Power BI and Tableau. • Experience in developing Power Point presentations. title: Lead Business Analyst
jobDescription:
Lead Business Analyst
- OCC Digital Platforms The Lead Business Analyst
- OCC Digital Platforms serves as the critical link between OCC Operations, Digital Product, Engineering, Data, Architecture, and Vendor teams to drive digital transformation across airline operational platforms. This role is responsible for translating complex operational requirements related to Flight Movement, Crew Operations, Flight Planning, Aircraft Operations, and Disruption Management into scalable digital solutions. The incumbent will lead requirement management, process re-engineering, API integration definition, product enhancement initiatives, and support modernization of OCC systems through cloud-native and data-driven technologies. Key Responsibilities OCC Digital Product Management Partner with OCC business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and identify digitization opportunities. Define business capabilities, product features, user stories, and acceptance criteria for OCC applications. Drive product enhancements across Flight Operations, Crew Operations, Flight Planning, and Operational Recovery platforms. Support digital transformation initiatives focused on automation, decision support, and operational efficiency. Act as a functional SME for OCC platforms and associated business processes. Flight Movement & Operations Control Develop strong understanding of end-to-end flight movement lifecycle. Analyze operational events such as delays, cancellations, diversions, aircraft swaps, and recovery scenarios. Define digital solutions supporting flight monitoring, operational alerts, disruption management, and decision support. Collaborate with OCC controllers and operational teams to improve operational visibility and situational awareness. Crew Operations & Recovery Understand Crew Planning, Scheduling, Tracking, Pairing, and Recovery processes. Define business rules related to crew legality, duty limitations, fatigue monitoring, and disruption recovery. Support digital initiatives aimed at crew optimization and operational resilience. Translate complex crew operational requirements into scalable technology solutions. API & System Integration Management Analyze and document API requirements across OCC ecosystems. Work with engineering teams on REST APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, and Enterprise Integrations. Review API specifications, Swagger/Open API documents, payload structures, JSON/XML schemas, and data mapping requirements. Define integration requirements across flight operations, crew systems, operational data stores, and enterprise platforms. Agile Delivery & Product Development Create: Business Requirement Documents (BRD) Functional Requirement Documents (FRD) User Stories Process Flow Diagrams Use Cases Acceptance Criteria Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, and product reviews. Support SIT, UAT, production deployment, and post-production validation. Manage requirement traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle. Vendor & Stakeholder Management Coordinate with product vendors, technology partners, and enterprise teams. Conduct requirement workshops and solution review sessions. Manage dependencies across business, digital, engineering, architecture, and infrastructure teams. Drive issue resolution and stakeholder alignment for critical initiatives. Required Skills Airline Domain Expertise Flight Movement Management OCC Operations Crew Scheduling & Crew Tracking Crew Recovery Flight Planning & Dispatch Operational Disruption Management Airline Operational Systems Digital & Technology Skills REST APIs JSON/XML Swagger/Open API Microservices Architecture Event-Driven Systems Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure) System Integration Patterns SQL & Data Analysis Enterprise Application Architecture Digital Product Lifecycle Business Analysis Skills Requirement Elicitation Process Modelling User Story Creation Functional Design Stakeholder Management Agile / Scrum Delivery UAT Management Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis

jobDescription:
Job Description Role Purpose: To support Cargo Commercial Operations through efficient management of agent onboarding, procurement processes, SAP workflows, vendor coordination, and financial transactions while ensuring compliance with organizational policies and timely stakeholder support. Coordinate with cargo agents and station teams across the network for operational and commercial requirements. Support business development initiatives through effective stakeholder coordination. title: Senior Analyst - Network Planning
jobDescription:
Position: Senior Analyst
- Network Planning Reporting to: Manager– Network Planning & Scheduling The team: Network Planning & scheduling at Indi Go is tasked to design, maintain. Implement and continuously optimize the most exciting and expansive air transportation network in India. The network planning group includes specialists at schedule design and management as well as analytical expertise with a high level of exposure and understanding for airline economics and its key drivers as part of this team, you will interact with the best aviation minds in the country, contribute to solving unique problems while building the nation’s air infrastructure and enhancing your career along the way. The

ROLE:
The selected candidate will join a group of high-quality experts in the field of schedule management, schedule design and implementation, in an area that is mission critical for the success of the airline.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor/master’s in Math/Statistic/Operations Research/Economics/Business/Engineering/ aviation Preferred Experience 2-4 years’ experience in airline Network Planning & Scheduling, Revenue Management or any airline analytical field. What you’ll do Schedule Management & Optimization Use Sabre’s Air Vision planning and scheduling software to ensure that the planned network does not exceed the total available aircraft. Regularly adjust the network schedules, equipment, aircraft flying patterns etc., to meet commercial and operational requirements such as, slot adherence, aircraft parking bay compliance, local airport manpower and optimal sub fleet utilization, accommodation of airport closures, maximizing crew efficiency & aircraft utilization, pattern of service, profitability, and strategic considerations. Monitor schedule performance and industry trends in conjunction with strategic groups and find solutions for market adjustments/additions or schedule changes to improve the existing network. In parallel, analyze and implement continuous improvement to achieve incremental crew productivity, improve maintenance feasibility and network connectivity. Schedule planning & design: Monitor industry trends and leverage internal and external traffic, profitability, demand data and come up with plans to improve & optimize the existing network. Participate in seasonal schedule design process to develop an operationally optimized, optimally utilized network that maximizes commercial feasibility. Execution: Collaborate with several internal teams such as crew planning, engineering, revenue management, Airport operations, marketing etc., to operationalize schedules/new routes/changes/cancellations etc. Publication & Distribution: Publish & distribute the planned schedule with RMS (revenue management system), and key stake holders within agreed timelines. Make sure the set schedule publishing guidelines are adhered to. Disseminate the plan to all down-line departments. Work on ad-hoc projects as per requirement. Preferred Skills Eager to solve complex problems, creative thinking and continuous improvement. Ability to multi-task on several scheduling projects and issues simultaneously. Advanced digital literacy: Experience in using Sabre Air Vision Planning and scheduling tool or an equivalent planning/scheduling software. In-depth understanding of airline scheduling, crew planning requirements, maintenance, and airport operations constraints. Knowledge of Business Intelligence & Data Visualization tools. title: Manager - AO&CS in the role of Business Analyst, Gurgaon
jobDescription:
Manager
- AO&CS in the role of Business Analyst, Gurgaon Job Summary The Business Analyst
- Airport Operations & Customer Services will support operational efficiency and customer experience initiatives by analyzing business processes, operational data, and service performance across airport operations. The role involves coordinating with subject matter experts & stakeholders, identifying improvement opportunities, and support implementation of operational projects. Key Responsibilities Gather and document business and operational requirements. Analyze airport operational processes and customer service performance. Prepare reports, dashboards, and KPI analysis. Support process improvement and automation initiatives. Coordinate with airport operations, airlines, IT teams, and service partners. Conduct gap analysis, root cause analysis, and impact assessments for operational and customer service issues. Monitor customer feedback and recommend service enhancements. Monitor operational KPIs and service-level performance. Develop business process maps, functional specifications, SOPs, and user stories. Analyze passenger feedback, complaints, and service trends to recommend improvements. Support customer journey mapping and service enhancement projects. Work with stakeholders to improve passenger satisfaction and airport service standards. Assist in developing customer service dashboards and reporting frameworks. Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and operational analytics. Interpret operational and customer data to support business decisions. Track KPIs such as: Passenger wait times Queue management OTP (On-Time Performance) Baggage delivery & Mishandling performance Customer NPS Aircraft Turn Around Time Safety & Security Parameters Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Aviation Management, Engineering, or related field. 3–7 years of experience in business analysis, airport operations, or customer service environments. MBA or Aviation or airport industry experience preferred. Required Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Knowledge of operations or customer service processes Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or reporting tools Excellent communication and stakeholder management Experience in process documentation and business analysis Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Improvement in operational efficiency Reduction in passenger complaints Enhanced customer satisfaction scores Timely project delivery Process compliance and SLA achievement Operational reporting accuracy Preferred Certifications CBAP / CCBA Lean Six Sigma PMP / Agile Certification Key Competencies Customer focus Operational excellence Data-driven decision-making Collaboration and coordination Continuous improvement mindset Safety Responsibilities Be aware of and comply with his / her safety responsibilities and accountabilities as laid down in the Indi Go SMS Manual. The risk tolerability is as per the risk matrix from the Indi Go SMS program.
